title: Deploy app descriptor (apps/*/deploy/config.json)
description: Declares how one app deploys: a name + one or more vendor targets. Discovered by this engine's discover action (12-apps/ci: scripts/deploy/discover.sh).

name.description: App identifier (image-name base / pages project base).

provider.description: Vendor name; must match a .github/deploy/targets.json entry.

image.description: GHCR image suffix; defaults to the app name.

target.description: Dockerfile build stage; defaults to runner.

cache.description: buildx cache scope; defaults to the image name.

role.description: How the deploy uses the image.

inputs.description: Extra root-anchored paths that rebuild this image (a trailing / is a directory prefix).

base.description: A stage built once per content of `inputs` and reused by every build until they change: pushed as <image>:base-<hash of inputs + Dockerfile + target>, always with reproducible layers, and handed to the build as build-arg `arg`. The Dockerfile's final stage starts FROM that arg.

target.description: Dockerfile stage the base image is built from.

arg.description: Build arg the final stage takes its FROM from; default it to `target` in the Dockerfile so a plain build still works.

inputs.description: git pathspecs of every file the base stage reads. Each must match a tracked file.

reproducible.description: Export with every file timestamp set to 1970-01-01 (SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=0, rewrite-timestamp), so an unchanged layer keeps its digest and is not pushed again. Only for images that serve no files by mtime: Caddy and other static servers build ETag and Last-Modified from it.

projectName.description: Static: Pages project name; defaults to the app name.

command.description: Worker: wrangler subcommand; defaults to deploy.
